{{Quote|What celestial body is more luminous than a singularity? Hiding in plain sight but more powerful than all.|Darth Guile|<ref name="DP" />}}
'''Darth Guile''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and eventually ascended to the rank of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. At some point during his reign, Guile compared the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to minuscule malignant cells that were unable to be detected, yet were able to spread throughout an individual's body and ultimately [[Death/Legends|kill]] its victim. His beliefs were recounted by the Dark Lord [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Guile was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DP" />
